title: NASA: Fill in a name, and you can have an exclusive coordinate in the universe
summary: NASA's Roman Space Telescope offers a public engagement program called 'Adopt a Pixel' where participants can name specific coordinates in the universe captured by the telescope, creating a personal connection to space exploration.
problem_solved: Engages the general public with space science and creates emotional investment in astronomical research.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to space exploration and inspires public interest in astronomy through a gamified naming experience.
